tracks.title: Cầu Khỉ Hai Tay Vịn
tracks.genre: Nam Bo ly folk ballad with guitar phim lom (Mekong)
tracks.subject: In a Vĩnh Long hamlet a girl is too scared to cross the one-log monkey bridge to her mother's house, and a young man who passes each evening says nothing but ties a bamboo handrail a little longer every day until she steps onto it.
